title: reMaestro plugin publisher
description: One of these lives at publishers/<id>.json. A publisher is a first-class record rather than a string in a manifest, because everything that later attaches to a publisher — a second plugin, a key rotation, a payee — has to attach to something. This file is submitted by the publisher it describes, which is exactly why it carries no tier: a verification written by its own subject is a claim, not a check. That record lives in verification/<id>.json, which only a maintainer writes — see docs/verification.md.

id.description: Reverse-DNS, lowercase. Must equal the file name without .json. Allocated once and never reassigned.

name.description: How the publisher is shown beside every one of their plugins, permanently. A claim, not an identity check, and the console says so.

contact.description: A URL a person can reach the publisher at — a GitHub profile, a project page. Public.

keys.description: Append-only. Pinned on first publication; every later archive must be signed by one of these. Removing or editing an entry is refused — a key is retired by setting status to 'revoked', which keeps the history readable.

publicKey.description: Base64 SubjectPublicKeyInfo, the same shape the hub's release verifier already reads.
